summary: Iteration 273: Automation Rules (Flexkeeping-style event-driven rule engine) fully tested. All 36 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified - panel accessible via Operations > Quality Assurance > 'Otomasyon kuralları'. All features working: catalog, CRUD, fire events, runs history, condition operators, action execution, template substitution, AND logic.
critical_code_review_comments: CATALOG: GET /api/automation/v2/catalog returns 8 triggers, 6 actions, 8 operators - all validated
RULES CREATE: POST /api/automation/v2/rules validates trigger enum, action type enum, operator enum (400 on invalid)
RULES LIST: GET /api/automation/v2/rules returns rules with enrichment (last_run_at, last_run_ok, run_count). Manager-only access enforced
RULES UPDATE: PATCH /api/automation/v2/rules/{id} updates enabled toggle and fields. 404 on missing. Validates action/operator on update
RULES DELETE: DELETE /api/automation/v2/rules/{id} admin-only (401/403 for non-auth)
FIRE EVENT: POST /api/automation/v2/fire emits domain event, returns matched_rules + runs[]. Supports dry_run mode
CONDITIONS: All 8 operators working (eq, ne, in, contains, gt, lt, gte, lte). Dot-path field access (e.g., 'guest.vip') working
ACTIONS: All 6 action types execute correctly - create_task, create_glitch, amenity_request, notify_role, set_room_status, tag_booking
TEMPLATE SUBSTITUTION: {guest_name}, {room_number}, {booking_ref} replaced from payload in action params
AND LOGIC: All conditions must pass for rule to match (verified with multi-condition rules)
RUNS HISTORY: GET /api/automation/v2/runs returns execution history with rule_id filter and limit
INTEGRATION: POST /api/bookings auto-fires 'booking_created' event via asyncio.create_task(fire_event(...))
INTEGRATION: POST /api/glitch-log with severity=critical auto-fires 'glitch_critical' event
Frontend: Sidebar Operations > Quality Assurance shows 'Otomasyon kuralları' button (data-testid='automation-rules-btn')
Frontend: Panel (data-testid='automation-rules-panel') displays rule cards with trigger badge, conditions, actions, run count, last run status
Frontend: Create modal (data-testid='automation-create-modal') has name input, trigger select, conditions builder, actions builder
Frontend: Toggle enable/disable (data-testid='automation-toggle-{id}'), runs history (data-testid='automation-runs-{id}'), delete (data-testid='automation-delete-{id}') all working
Frontend: Runs modal (data-testid='automation-runs-modal') shows execution history with timestamps, event type, action results
Frontend: All UI text in Turkish as specified
seed_data_creation: Test rules created via backend tests with TEST_ prefix, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Automation Rules module fully verified. Access via Operations > Quality Assurance > 'Otomasyon kuralları'. Endpoints: /api/automation/v2/catalog (GET), /api/automation/v2/rules (CRUD), /api/automation/v2/fire (POST), /api/automation/v2/runs (GET).
